question: What surpasses the toil of carrying mere burdens?
premises: Carrying a load of wood represents exhausting but unessential labor.
Among such efforts one thing stands out as life-giving.
That one thing is supreme in value.
inference: Beyond burdensome toil, there is one supreme life-giving thing.
uncertainties: The referent of the one life-giving thing is implied rather than explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: From this toil of carrying a load of wood, there is one supreme, life-giving thing.
